basic_info.description: This charming two-unit building in Inner Parkside, currently tenant-occupied, offers distinct living spaces with flexibility and privacy, along with one-car garage parking and ample storage. The upper unit features a spacious layout with two bedrooms and one bathroom. The living room, complete with a fireplace, provides a comfortable space for  relaxation and entertaining. Adjacent to the living room is a dining area that leads into the kitchen with convenient access to the backyard-perfect for outdoor activities. This unit also boasts a partial ocean view, adding a serene and picturesque touch to the living space. The lower unit, more compact in size, offers one bedroom and one bathroom. The smaller kitchen is fully functional, and the living room provides a cozy, inviting atmosphere. Both units are filled with natural light and offer  practical layouts, each with its own private entrance, making this property an excellent choice for those seeking independent living spaces within one building. Conveniently located near West Portal Ave and Taraval Street shopping, cafes, and restaurants. Enjoy nearby Larsen Park, Stern Grove, Stonestown Galleria, San Francisco State University, and top-rated schools. The property is also easily accessible to Muni, 19th Ave & I-280.
